text: Illustration. A different car, April 20th account
In April, an empty Waymo was swept into Salado Creek.
observed: 16.0 to 16.8 s closer overhead creek. The white car rides diagonally in the middle of the brown water, nose toward lower left, carried left. A scalloped soft foam mass trails at its upper right end. At 16.0 to 16.2 s two pale smooth curved lines spread leftward from the car's front corner, one curving up and one down; they fade by 16.8 s. The roof shows a round sensor and small gray seat back shapes with no figures. The car passes below the slab and by 16.8 s is half out of frame at left. No separating contact shadow or clear scale rise is distinguishable. Thin wavy lines remain on the water. Car is above the caption box throughout.
